name: operamind-copilot-bridge
description: Receive approved OperaMind Coding Plan tasks without handoff files.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Only local diagnostics run while untrusted; OperaMind coding task operations remain disabled.

scripts.package:vsix: npm test && node --check extension.js && node --check bridgeClient.js && node --check diagnostics.js && node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true})" && vsce package --allow-missing-repository --out dist/operamind-copilot-bridge.vsix

commands.title: OperaMind: 承認済みタスクを確認
OperaMind: Bridge Token を安全に登録
OperaMind: 現在のタスクを再開
OperaMind: 現在のタスクを取消
OperaMind: ローカル環境を診断

operamind.bridge.pollSeconds.description: Seconds between local Bridge task checks.

operamind.bridge.acceptedBy.description: Audit label recorded when you confirm a task in VS Code.
